entities.summary: Aghdam is a town and the nominal capital of the Aghdam District of Azerbaijan. Founded in the 18th century, it was granted city status in 1828 and grew considerably during the Soviet period. Aghdam lies 26 km from Khankendi at the eastern foot of the Karabakh Range, on the outskirts of the Karabakh plain.
